name: dedup-namespace-leak
reading: Every cross-namespace pair here is a pair the deduplicator would have adjudicated had both memories been in the store at the time, and a DUPLICATE verdict on one drops a fact from a conversation that never contained its supposed duplicate. A window filled by foreign memories also crowds out the within-namespace duplicates dedup exists to catch.
status: Fixed 2026-09-16. `Deduplicator._neighbours` now drops index hits whose user_id differs from the candidate's, and the ingest fingerprint records the comparison scope so a store written under the old policy refuses to resume. The measurement below is left as it was taken: it is the evidence the fix was made on, and it describes the store, which has not changed.
